enriched.title: Vocabulário, Gramática e Pronúncia Básica em Inglês
enriched.summary: Esta aula apresenta vocabulário essencial, conceitos básicos de gramática e prática de pronúncia em inglês. Os alunos irão aprender novas palavras, sua aplicação em frases e como usá-las corretamente em diferentes contextos.

vocabulary.definition: A living organism that has life.
examples: Humans are a type of living being.
Plants and animals are living beings.

vocabulary.definition: The least good, most unfavorable, or most severe.
examples: That was the worst movie I have ever seen.
This is the worst day of my life.

vocabulary.definition: Persistence in doing something despite difficulty or delay in achieving success.
examples: Her perseverance helped her achieve her goals.
Perseverance is key to overcoming obstacles.

vocabulary.definition: The smallest unit of a chemical compound that can take part in a chemical reaction.
examples: Water is made up of two hydrogen molecules and one oxygen molecule.
Molecules are the building blocks of matter.

vocabulary.definition: To remove impurities or unwanted material from something.
examples: He used a coffee filter to remove the grounds.
The air conditioner has a filter to clean the air.

vocabulary.definition: Without any flaws or defects; as good as possible.
examples: This is the perfect solution to our problem.

vocabulary.definition: Something that holds or catches attention because it is unusual or exciting.
examples: She told an interesting story about her trip.

studyTips: Pratique a pronúncia das palavras com a ajuda de dicionários online que fornecem áudio.
Crie frases simples usando o vocabulário aprendido para reforçar o uso em contexto.
originalExamples: Humans are a type of living being. (Os humanos são um tipo de ser vivo.)
That was the worst movie I have ever seen. (Esse foi o pior filme que eu já vi.)
Her perseverance helped her achieve her goals. (A perseverança dela a ajudou a alcançar seus objetivos.)
Water is made up of two hydrogen molecules and one oxygen molecule. (A água é composta por duas moléculas de hidrogênio e uma de oxigênio.)
He used a coffee filter to remove the grounds. (Ele usou um filtro de café para remover os grãos.)
Her performance was perfect. (A performance dela foi perfeita.)
The book was very interesting. (O livro era muito interessante.)
